about.title: About the Hotel
about.tradition: Tradition and comfort in Ponte Nova
about.p1: Hotel & Restaurant Paraíso is a benchmark in hospitality and gastronomy in the Zona da Mata region of Minas Gerais. Located in Ponte Nova, MG, we welcome both business travelers and families seeking comfort, convenience, and an authentic Minas Gerais experience.
about.p2: With accommodations ranging from functional to sophisticated — from our Standard room to the Master Suite with jacuzzi — we offer options for every guest. Our restaurant serves the finest regional and international cuisine, with breakfast included in every stay.
about.p3: The hotel features free parking, high-speed Wi-Fi throughout, an event venue for corporate gatherings, and even an electric vehicle charging station. We are also pet friendly — because we know your companion is part of the family.
about.p4: Just 150 km from Belo Horizonte, with easy access via the BR-120 and BR-262 highways, Ponte Nova is a regional hub that attracts professionals from various fields. Our hotel is the natural choice for those who need a comfortable and well-located base in the region.
